summary: Acer 16 Predator Neo is a powerful gaming laptop with Intel Core i5-10300H processor, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 Ti graphics card, and 16GB DDR4 RAM. It features a 512GB NVMe SSD and has been reported to experience thermal throttling and BSODs due to driver issues or hardware conflicts.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and BSODs due to driver issues or hardware conflicts
suggested_solution: Update drivers, clean dust from fans, and monitor temperatures to prevent thermal throttling. Run a full system scan with antivirus software to detect and remove any malware that may be causing BSODs.
